name: Siôn Cent
credit: No confirmed portrait sourced for this archive.
bio: Siôn Cent was a Welsh poet of the early fifteenth century, associated with Kentchurch in Herefordshire, whose verse turns on the vanity of worldly pride and the certainty of death.
His poem "The Noble's Grave" is given in English verse by Alfred Perceval Graves in A Celtic Psaltery (1917).

poems.title: The Noble's Grave
poems.author: Siôn Cent
poems.note: After Sion Cent, priest of Kentchurch in Hereford.
